purpose: Preregistration of L1.5 observable-bridge model families, written BEFORE any fitting.

split_protocol.note: Internal DEV split only. FRESH (seeds 101-106) is never read or fit against by W2.

predeclared_transforms: sqrt(2*log(n))  -- extreme-value scale factor for max of n roughly-Gaussian projections
sqrt(1 - R**2)  -- circular/spherical spread proxy from mean resultant length R
products of the above with legal first-moment columns

F0_LOW.description: Own-only Samuelson/extreme-value ansatz: predicts the basin's own-axis extreme deviation only, ignoring rival centroid entirely.

F1_LEGAL.description: Joint own+rival first-moment family using only LEGAL columns: models max(s_own, s_best) via the own and rival mean projections yo, yb, plus the same extreme-value spread term, plus shape (skew), rival geometry (cob), and recent-motion (dmu).
F1_LEGAL.formula_string: G_F1 = a0 + a1*yo + a2*yb + a3*sqrt(2*log(n))*sqrt(1-R**2) + a4*skew + a5*cob + a6*dmu

F2_AUG.description: F1_LEGAL plus the PROPOSED_AUGMENTATION second-moment columns (so, sb, rho), each so/sb scaled by the same extreme-value factor a_n = sqrt(2*log(n)) used elsewhere; rho enters unscaled as a correlation-shape term.
F2_AUG.formula_string: G_F2 = a0 + a1*yo + a2*yb + a3*sqrt(2*log(n))*sqrt(1-R**2) + a4*skew + a5*cob + a6*dmu + a7*sqrt(2*log(n))*so + a8*sqrt(2*log(n))*sb + a9*rho

metrics_to_report: sign agreement (fraction of rows where sign(F_hat) == sign(G_birth))
Pearson correlation of F_hat vs G_birth (signed-margin correlation)
false-early count: F_hat > 0 while G_birth <= 0 (predicted birth that does not occur)
false-late count: F_hat <= 0 while G_birth > 0 (missed/late birth)
all of the above also restricted to phase==49 (the redraw step, where births structurally occur)

fiber_ambiguity_protocol.description: On DEV (all seeds), quantile-bin the ~4 highest-importance legal inputs of F1 (5 bins each), and separately for F2's inputs, then report the fraction of rows falling in cells that contain both signs of G_birth, and the row-weighted mean conditional binary sign entropy within cells.
fiber_ambiguity_protocol.importance_rule: feature importance = |coefficient| * std(feature) computed on the fit (seeds 1-4) sample; top 4 non-intercept basis terms selected per family.

compute_note: To keep compute modest, all fitting/evaluation/fiber analysis uses phase==49 rows in full plus a seeded 20% uniform random sample of all other-phase rows (rng seed 12345).
prereg_timestamp_note: Written before any model was fit; frozen coefficients for F1_LEGAL and F2_AUG are produced only afterward, on all seeds 1-6, in BRIDGE_FREEZE.json.
